input_contract: InitialResponseEvent, HintEvent, FinalResponseEvent and IndependentRetestEvent are distinct append-only events. Task/scoring versions must be nonempty and pinned; event_time and recorded_at are UTC epoch seconds with explicit client/server clock IDs, BOUNDED synchronization and maximum 300-second skew. recorded_at is nondecreasing in append order; event_time retains its own event chronology. Every event digest is recomputed. IndependentRetestEvent binds F04.OBS.RETEST and P06.ACT.OBSERVE.OBS; a bare independent_retest boolean is never evidence.
negative_boundary: 生成答案不属于学习者响应；提示后正确不自动等于独立掌握。
output_contract: Append-only observations; no overwrite; assisted and independent channels remain distinct.
